### Dataset information
```{r Dataset_Info}

# Title: Key molecular alterations in endothelial cells in human glioblastoma uncovered through single-cell RNA sequencing
# Authors: Xie Y, He L, Lugano R, Zhang Y et al.,
# Species: Human
# organ:Glioblastoma
# cell type: Various - CD31 Positive cells
# Sample info:

# GEO accession number: GSE162631

# Input data is raw counts matrix as stated in Gene omnibus page

```

### Correlation analysis - just endothelial cells
```{r correlation_analysis_Endothelial}



DefaultAssay(endothelial.seurat) <- "integrated"



# Code adapted from Prof. Hoelzel 

# Create output directorys
if(!dir.exists("output/figures/Correlation_analysis")){
  dir.create("output/figures/Correlation_analysis", 
             recursive = T)
}

if(!dir.exists("output/tables/Correlation_analysis")){
  dir.create("output/tables/Correlation_analysis", 
             recursive = T)
}

################
# Functions
################

probeCor <- function(x, gp, method="pearson") {
  
  em <- x
  prbcor<-apply(em, 1, cor, em[gp,], method=method)
  return(prbcor)
  
}

probeCor.test <- function(x, gp, method="pearson") {
  
  em <- x
  prbcort <- apply(em, 1, cor.test, em[gp,], method=method)
  return(prbcort)
} 


# Get data
normed.data <- as.matrix(endothelial.seurat@assays$integrated@data)

# Identify lowest 30% expressed genes in dataset 
q.val <- quantile(rowMeans(normed.data), probs = 0.3)
low.exprs <- rowMeans(normed.data) < q.val

# Filter low expressed genes
filt.data <- normed.data[!low.exprs, ]

# Calculate pearson correlation for all genes vs. CXCL12
cor.res <- probeCor(filt.data, 
                    gp = "CXCL12", 
                    method = "pearson")

# Sort correlation values
cor.res <- as.data.frame(sort(cor.res, 
                                 decreasing = TRUE))

colnames(cor.res) <- "Cor.val"


# Calculate statistics 
cor.res.pval <- probeCor.test(filt.data, 
                              gp = "CXCL12", 
                              method = "pearson")

cor.res.pval <- unlist(sapply(cor.res.pval, "[", "p.value"))

names(cor.res.pval) <- gsub(".p.value", "", names(cor.res.pval))

cor.res.pval <- as.data.frame(sort(cor.res.pval,
                                   decreasing = FALSE))

colnames(cor.res.pval) <- "P.val"


head(cor.res.pval)
tail(cor.res.pval)


# Combine both pval and correlation statistic 
cor.df <- merge(cor.res, cor.res.pval, by = "row.names")

colnames(cor.df)[1] <- c("GeneID")

# Calculate FDR adjusted P value
cor.df$FDR <- p.adjust(cor.df$P.val, method = "fdr")


# Write data to file 
write.csv(cor.df, "output/tables/Correlation_analysis/Correlation_Endothelial_cells.csv")



################################
# Heatmap of top correlations
################################

Idents(endothelial.seurat) <- endothelial.seurat@meta.data$EC_subcluster
DefaultAssay(endothelial.seurat) <- "integrated"

small.seurat <- subset(endothelial.seurat, 
                       downsample = 300)


up.genes <- cor.df %>%
  dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::top_n(20, Cor.val) %>% 
  dplyr::pull(GeneID)

up.genes <- unique(c("CXCL12", up.genes))

Idents(small.seurat) <- small.seurat@meta.data$EC_subcluster

DoHeatmap(small.seurat, 
          features = up.genes, 
          angle = 90,
          size = 3,
          raster = FALSE)

dev.copy(pdf, "output/figures/Correlation_analysis/Heatmap_Endothelial_cells_top20_corr_genes.pdf")
dev.off()



# Sort by CXCL12 expression 
temp.df <- small.seurat@assays$integrated@data
cell.use <- colnames(small.seurat@assays$integrated@data)[order(temp.df["CXCL12", ])]

# Set idents
Idents(small.seurat) <- small.seurat@meta.data$cell_type

# Positively correlated genes
DoHeatmap(small.seurat, 
          cells = cell.use,
          features = up.genes, 
          raster = FALSE)

dev.copy(pdf, "output/figures/Correlation_analysis/Heatmap_Endothelial_cells_top_positively_correlated.pdf")
dev.off()


dn.genes <- cor.df %>%
  dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::top_n(-20, Cor.val) %>% 
  dplyr::pull(GeneID)

dn.genes <- unique(c("CXCL12", dn.genes))

# Neg correlated genes
DoHeatmap(small.seurat, 
          cells = cell.use,
          features = dn.genes, 
          raster = FALSE)

dev.copy(pdf, "output/figures/Correlation_analysis/Heatmap_Endothelial_cells_top_Neg_correlated.pdf")
dev.off()

```
 

### Correlation analysis - All cells
```{r correlation_analysis_All_Cells}

DefaultAssay(integrated.seurat) <- "integrated"
integrated.seurat # 56,138 genes and 97,584 cells 


# dataset is very large, downsample for correlation analysis 

length(unique(integrated.seurat@meta.data$cell_type)) # 12 cell type annotations

Idents(integrated.seurat) <- integrated.seurat@meta.data$cell_type

downsampled.seurat <- subset(integrated.seurat, 
                             downsample = 3000)

rm(integrated.seurat)

# export seurat object that was used for correlation calculation 
saveRDS(downsampled.seurat, "Exported_RDS_files/Downsampled_Dataset.rds")



# Code adapted from Prof. Hoelzel 

# Create output directorys
if(!dir.exists("output/figures/Correlation_analysis_all_cells")){
  dir.create("output/figures/Correlation_analysis_all_cells", 
             recursive = T)
}

if(!dir.exists("output/tables/Correlation_analysis_all_cells")){
  dir.create("output/tables/Correlation_analysis_all_cells", 
             recursive = T)
}

################
# Functions
################

probeCor <- function(x, gp, method="pearson") {
  
  em <- x
  prbcor<-apply(em, 1, cor, em[gp,], method=method)
  return(prbcor)
  
}

probeCor.test <- function(x, gp, method="pearson") {
  
  em <- x
  prbcort <- apply(em, 1, cor.test, em[gp,], method=method)
  return(prbcort)
} 


# Get data
normed.data <- as.matrix(downsampled.seurat@assays$integrated@data)

# Identify lowest 30% expressed genes in dataset 
q.val <- quantile(rowMeans(normed.data), probs = 0.3)
low.exprs <- rowMeans(normed.data) < q.val

# Filter low expressed genes
filt.data <- normed.data[!low.exprs, ]

# Calculate pearson correlation for all genes vs. CXCL12
cor.res <- probeCor(filt.data, 
                    gp = "CXCL12", 
                    method = "pearson")

# Sort correlation values
cor.res <- as.data.frame(sort(cor.res, 
                                 decreasing = TRUE))

colnames(cor.res) <- "Cor.val"


# Calculate statistics 
cor.res.pval <- probeCor.test(filt.data, 
                              gp = "CXCL12", 
                              method = "pearson")

cor.res.pval <- unlist(sapply(cor.res.pval, "[", "p.value"))

names(cor.res.pval) <- gsub(".p.value", "", names(cor.res.pval))

cor.res.pval <- as.data.frame(sort(cor.res.pval,
                                   decreasing = FALSE))

colnames(cor.res.pval) <- "P.val"


head(cor.res.pval)
tail(cor.res.pval)


# Combine both pval and correlation statistic 
cor.df <- merge(cor.res, cor.res.pval, by = "row.names")

colnames(cor.df)[1] <- c("GeneID")

# Calculate FDR adjusted P value
cor.df$FDR <- p.adjust(cor.df$P.val, method = "fdr")


# Write data to file 
write.csv(cor.df, "output/tables/Correlation_analysis_all_cells/Correlation_all_cells.csv")



################################
# Heatmap of top correlations
################################

DefaultAssay(downsampled.seurat) <- "integrated"
Idents(downsampled.seurat) <- downsampled.seurat@meta.data$cell_type

small.seurat <- subset(downsampled.seurat,

up.genes <- cor.df %>%

up.genes <- unique(c("CXCL12", up.genes))

# Sort by CXCL12 expression 
temp.df <- small.seurat@assays$integrated@data
cell.use <- colnames(small.seurat@assays$integrated@data)[order(temp.df["CXCL12", ])]

# Set idents
Idents(small.seurat) <- small.seurat@meta.data$cell_type
```

### DEG calculation
```{r DEG_calculation}

if(long.compute){
  for(i in seq_along(seurat.list)){
    DefaultAssay(seurat.list[[i]]) <- "SCT"
  }
  
  #BiocManager::install('limma')
  #library("limma")
  
  
  markers.vec <- lapply(seurat.list, 
                        FUN = Seurat::FindAllMarkers,
                        only.pos = FALSE)
  
  
  # Save dataset with dim reduction
  saveRDS(markers.vec, "Exported_RDS_files/DEG_markers.rds")
  
  
}

```
